title: Ops sync rapid agenda + action dump
content:
Quick scratch for weekly ops sync (serving runtime / infra / console). Not a polished doc — brain dump to shape agenda and capture actions before the meeting.

Meeting info:
- When: weekly, Tue 10:30-11:00 PT (30m) — keep tight; call starts on the 5.
- Who: eng-serving-runtime + infra on rotation (this week: Maya, Ellie, Arjun).
- Goal: unblock high-risk infra regressions, short rollout decisions, and action accountability.

Agenda draft (30m total)
1) 10:30 - 10:34 (4m) Quick pulse: live incidents / major deploys (owners call out): 
   - Cache invalidation incident (SRE) — current state?
   - Dedicated capacity rollout for eu-west (prod smoke results)
2) 10:34 - 10:40 (6m) Latency variance across long-tail requests (console traces) — triage quick hits.
3) 10:40 - 10:46 (6m) New batching kube node sizing experiment — decide toggle for next 48h trial.
4) 10:46 - 10:52 (6m) Telemetry gaps: token-level cost attribution missing for a few routes. Quick owners + timeline.
5) 10:52 - 10:58 (6m) Rollout gating checklist update (canary success criteria ambiguous) + follow-ups.
6) 10:58 - 11:00 (2m) Rapid round-robin: blockers & next steps.

Prep notes / context snippets:
- Cache invalidation: saw ~3% error spike on 2026-03-08 22:05 UTC when prefix cache TTL dropped due to a malformed key. Root cause suspected in the console-side key builder (PR ref below). Could be related to recent key schema change (RFC-keys-v2).
- Latency traces: long-tail looks concentrated on 1% of requests with seq_len > 2048 hitting kernel fallback path. Need to know whether to force quantized variant for those customer routes.
- Batching experiment: current node type g5.4x used; suggestion in draft is to move to g5.8x for better throughput but might hurt cost per-token. Need a concrete metric: target 20% p95 reduction or abort.
- Telemetry: missing token attribution for the embeddings endpoint when using streaming fallback. Appears to be a race in the router instrumentation (trace id mismatch).

Open questions I want to raise (fast):
- Do we accept a temporary 10% cost bump for 72h to validate the g5.8x throughput improvement? Who signs off?
- Is the canary success criteria (error < 0.1% and p95 < 250ms) still appropriate for the new model variant?
- Which product routes are OK to pin to quantized variants automatically? (list TBD)

Action items (capture during meeting — pre-seeded entries):
- [ ] Investigate malformed cache key path and add guard (owner: Maya) — target: 2026-03-13.
- [ ] Run 48h g5.8x trial and capture p50/p95/cost, then report (owner: Arjun) — target: start 2026-03-13, results by 2026-03-15.
- [ ] Add token-level telemetry for streaming embeddings route; quick patch + deploy (owner: Ellie) — target: 2026-03-14.
- [ ] Clarify canary gating doc and add explicit rollback criteria; update Confluence (owner: Ryan) — target: 2026-03-14.
- [ ] Build short list of product routes safe for auto-quantize and bring to next sync (owner: Maya + Product PM) — target: 2026-03-16.

Notes-to-self / leader prompts (things to say if we get stuck):
- "If p95 wins but cost doubles, can we stage partial rollout by customer tier?"
- "We should default to safety: if a route isn't in the safe-list, keep it off for now and add to an eval harness."
- "Ask SRE: are we comfortable with a 72h cost-aware experiment; do we need finance OK?"

Quick links to call out in the meeting (read before):
- PR: key-builder fix draft — https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/778
- Telemetry issue: JIRA-TRC-2126
- Canary doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/canary-guidance

Random scratch / TODOs:
- Consider adding a one-line summary at top of future agendas (status: green/yellow/red). Makes exec review easier.
- Prototype an infra-kpi dashboard widget for the console that shows token-cost delta vs baseline — low effort spike (2d).

Meeting checklist (for facilitator):
- Start on time; keep people muted unless speaking.
- Ask owners to state one-sentence updates only. Capture decisions in meeting notes channel.
- If a discussion will exceed 6 minutes, call a follow-up deep-dive offline and capture owner.

End of dump. Will tidy after the sync and convert to a polished agenda + meeting notes template.

(Version history: rough draft 2026-03-09; updated with telemetry debug notes 2026-03-12)
